title: Get fast proof of live sessions and terminal work

intentCoverage.report:
**Verdict.** Caught.

**Story and revision.** `SEED-413#speed-dashboard-live-session-and-terminal-proof`, slice 2, at `5297dca53cae2f317a7529bf20fb72b473f15349`. A successful Delete must keep the session record absent when a read requested before Delete arrives afterward.

**Fault and observation.** In an isolated detached worktree, `dashboard/src/agentLaunches.ts` bypassed the `deletedAt` filter at lines 160–164, passing the incoming records through unchanged. The maintained fixture held the earlier lookup while the user confirmed Delete. The faulted run passed all four immediate absence checks before releasing that reply. The separate “Keep the session history” card displayed Working, confirming the UI applied the late reply. The browser screenshot then showed the deleted “Ship the launch guide” row back under the story card as State unknown and back in the open Sessions sidebar. The matcher’s DOM output identified the resurrected article as `claude:ship-the-launch-guide-session`.

**Maintained check.** The same one-case Chromium Vitest selection ran for baseline, fault, and restoration through `npm run test:dashboard:frontend`, two workers, and the exact title “a read asked before the deletion and answered after it does not bring the entry back” in `dashboard/frontend-tests/sessions/agent-launch-story-card-delete-problems.spec.ts`. The faulted run exited 1 on its second `expectDeletedSession()` call at line 147. The catch was the story-card entry’s `not.toBeInTheDocument()` assertion in `dashboard/frontend-tests/sessions/session-card-page.ts:86`. The baseline and restored runs each passed one test. The tracked state returned to the original clean revision. The scratch worktree was retired after verification.

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing case. This probe requires no additional proof or follow-up for the checked promise. No prior repair disposition was needed for this fault.

- **Test runtime.** Measured Vitest run durations were 3.27 s baseline, 16.37 s faulted, and 1.81 s restored, totaling 21.45 s.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable because the check captured no human effort measure.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable because active agent time was not measured separately from setup and waits.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 109294 ms (measured), from 1795482866953 to 1795482976247 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

**Wrap-up disposition.** Checked revision `5297dca53cae2f317a7529bf20fb72b473f15349`, Caught, no follow-up.
